commands.command:
sudo sh -c '
set -eu
umask 077
die() { printf "[myriarch-install] ERROR [%s] %s\n" "$1" "$2" >&2; exit 1; }
[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || die privilege_required "this command has to run as root (sudo)"
srv=$1 proto=$2 ca=$3 tf=$4 file=$5 sum=$6
shift 6
for t in curl tar gzip sha256sum mktemp; do
  command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die tool_missing "$t is required and was not found"
done
d=$(mktemp -d /root/myriarch-setup.XXXXXX) || die directory_unsafe "cannot create a private working directory below /root"
cleanup() { rm -rf "$d"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
trap "exit 1" HUP INT TERM
if [ -n "$tf" ]; then
  if [ ! -f "$tf" ] || [ ! -r "$tf" ]; then die file_unreadable "the token file $tf is not a readable file"; fi
  tok=$(tr -d "\r\n[:space:]" <"$tf")
  own=
else
  IFS= read -r tok || :
  own=1
fi
case $tok in
  "") die option_missing "the enrollment token is empty" ;;
  *@@*) die option_missing "the placeholder of the enrollment token was not replaced" ;;
  *[!A-Za-z0-9_.~+/=-]*) die option_invalid "the enrollment token contains characters that a token cannot have" ;;
esac
if [ -n "$own" ]; then
  tf=$d/enrollment-token
  printf "%s\n" "$tok" >"$tf"
fi
printf "[myriarch-install] downloading the installer bundle %s from %s\n" "$file" "$srv"
printf "header = \042Authorization: Bearer %s\042\n" "$tok" |
  curl -fsSg --retry 3 --proto "$proto" --tlsv1.2 ${ca:+--cacert "$ca"} -K - -o "$d/$file" "$srv/api/v1/install/bundles/$file" ||
  die download_failed "the installer bundle could not be downloaded from $srv (check the address, the certificate of the server and the enrollment token)"
printf "%s  %s\n" "$sum" "$file" >"$d/SHA256SUMS"
(cd "$d" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS >/dev/null 2>&1) ||
  die checksum_mismatch "the installer bundle does not have the SHA-256 given in the command (a changed bundle, or the answer of another address or a redirect); nothing was unpacked"
printf "[myriarch-install] the SHA-256 of the installer bundle is the one in the command; unpacking it\n"
tar -xzf "$d/$file" -C "$d" || die archive_invalid "the installer bundle could not be unpacked"
bash "$d/deploy/scripts/install-linux.sh" --server "$srv" --token-file "$tf" ${ca:+--ca-file "$ca"} "$@" </dev/null
' sh 'http://localhost:8080' '=http,https' '/etc/ssl/myriarch-ca.pem' '' 'myriarch-updater_0.2.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz' 'c8737718a8e31664e2acb920db0670a0508e3ff8811766612fbb54cfd4ab2d99' '--fleet' 'linux-hosts' '--collector-version' '0.162.0' '--site-type' 'edge' '--site-id' '042' '--site-name' 'Edge site 42 (north)' '--site-country' 'NL' '--site-region' 'north' '--site-timezone' 'Europe/Amsterdam' '--environment' 'prod' '--insecure' <<'MYRIARCH_TOKEN_END'
@@MYRIARCH_ENROLLMENT_TOKEN@@
MYRIARCH_TOKEN_END
